avatars.name: Octopus
avatars.prompt: Chunky 2D sticker-style cartoon avatar of a friendly octopus, centered square portrait. Extremely simple shapes, heavy black contour lines, and bright pop-art flat coloring. Features big round cartoon eyes, a wide happy smile, and a tiny red-and-white striped sailor cap tilted on its head, with two curled tentacles waving at the bottom. Zero fine detail, flat vector graphics, clean minimalist silhouette, solid teal background.

avatars.name: Crab
avatars.prompt: Chunky 2D sticker-style cartoon avatar of a cheerful red crab, centered square portrait. Extremely simple shapes, heavy black contour lines, and bright pop-art flat coloring. Features big googly eyes on short stalks, a wide toothy grin, and two oversized claws raised up in a friendly wave. Zero fine detail, flat vector graphics, clean minimalist silhouette, solid sky-blue background.

avatars.name: Whale
avatars.prompt: Chunky 2D sticker-style cartoon avatar of a smiling blue whale, centered square portrait. Extremely simple shapes, heavy black contour lines, and bright pop-art flat coloring. Features a big round friendly face with rosy cheeks, a small water spout fountain on top of its head, and a light belly with simple stripes. Zero fine detail, flat vector graphics, clean minimalist silhouette, solid warm-yellow background.

avatars.name: Pufferfish
avatars.prompt: Chunky 2D sticker-style cartoon avatar of a puffed-up yellow pufferfish, centered square portrait. Extremely simple shapes, heavy black contour lines, and bright pop-art flat coloring. Features a perfectly round body with a few short rounded spikes, big surprised eyes, and a tiny pursed mouth with small side fins. Zero fine detail, flat vector graphics, clean minimalist silhouette, solid lavender background.

avatars.name: Seagull
avatars.prompt: Chunky 2D sticker-style cartoon avatar of a cheeky seagull, centered square portrait. The whole bird is small enough to sit fully inside the frame, with wide empty margins on every side and nothing touching the edges. Extremely simple shapes, heavy black contour lines, and bright pop-art flat coloring. Features a round white head and body with grey wings folded at its sides, a big bright orange beak, and a mischievous half-lidded grin. Zero fine detail, flat vector graphics, clean minimalist silhouette, solid coral background.
edits: Change only the face: give the seagull big, round, wide-open friendly eyes with no eyelids, and a cheerful open smile. Keep everything else exactly the same: pose, size, framing, colours, outline and background.

avatars.name: Captain
avatars.prompt: Stylized 2D animated-series character portrait of a cheerful middle-aged sea captain with dark brown skin, head and shoulders facing the viewer, square composition with the face centred and the shoulders running off the bottom edge. Clean confident line work, flat cel shading with a single soft shadow tone, bold simplified shapes, an expressive friendly face. A weathered navy tricorn hat with gold trim, a neat short grey beard, and a warm crinkly-eyed smile. Solid cobalt background, no gradient, no scenery.

avatars.name: Puffin
avatars.prompt: Handmade stop-motion clay character of a round little puffin, sculpted from plasticine with visible thumbprints and soft rounded shapes, photographed from the chest up as a centred square portrait. Big simple glossy eyes, a chunky friendly face, gentle studio lighting. A big bright orange-and-red striped beak, a soft white chest, and a tiny knitted blue scarf. Plain solid sky-blue paper backdrop, shallow depth of field.

avatars.name: Sea otter
avatars.prompt: Photorealistic wildlife portrait of a sea otter, head and shoulders filling a square frame, looking straight at the camera with a calm expression, sharp focus on the eyes, soft studio lighting. Wet glossy brown fur, long white whiskers, and its small paws held together at its chest. The animal is cleanly cut out against a solid flat teal background, no scenery, no shadow on the background.

avatars.name: Diving helmet
avatars.prompt: Bold flat graphic icon of a deep-sea diver, a minimal face that fills a square frame, built from only three or four flat colours and thick solid black shapes, no outlines, no shading, no texture. A round brass diving helmet with a big round front window, a friendly face with simple dot eyes and a smile seen through the glass, and a ring of bolts around the collar. Solid crimson background.

avatars.name: Astronaut
avatars.prompt: 16-bit pixel art portrait of a cheerful young astronaut, head and shoulders centred in a square frame, chunky visible square pixels, a limited palette of about twelve colours, a crisp one-pixel dark outline, a friendly face. A white space helmet with its visor flipped up, a round face with freckles and a big smile, and a small round mission patch on the suit. Solid violet background, no dithering on the background.
